The '''Venezuelan Mathematical Association''' (Spanish: {{lang|es|Asociación Matemática Venezolana}}, '''AMV''') is a [[mathematical society]] founded in [[Venezuela]] in January 1990.
The AMV has chapters in four Venezuelan cities, and is a member of the {{ill|Unión Matemática de América Latina y el Caribe|es}}.{{r|umalca}} It is recognised by the [[International Mathematics Union]].{{r|imu}}

==History==
The precursor to the AMV was the Venezuelan Mathematical Society (Spanish: {{lang|es|Sociedad Venezolana de Matemáticas}}), which was founded at the Third Venezuelan Congress of Mathematicians, held in October 1980 at the [[University of Zulia]] in [[Maracaibo]].{{r|mactutor|origen94}} The society functioned poorly and soon after effectively ceased to exist.{{r|mactutor}}

Following several failed attempts at reactivating the society, the Venezuelan Mathematical Association was founded in January 1990. Within a year the AMV had branches in [[Caracas]], [[Maracaibo]], [[Mérida, Mérida|Mérida]], and [[Barquisimeto]].{{r|mactutor}}

Since the mid 2010s the AMV has had difficulty fulfulling its duties, due to the ongoing [[crisis in Venezuela]].{{r|mactutor}} The AMV has been unable to physically publish its Bulletin since 2013, and struggles to pay membership fees to the [[International Mathematics Union|IMU]].{{r|mactutor}} The crisis has also led many mathematicians to leave the country.{{r|nacional}}

==Activities==
The AMV organises the Venezuelan Mathematics Seminars (Spanish: {{lang|es|Jornadas Matemáticas Venezolanas}}), the first of which were held at the First Venezuelan Congress of Mathematicians in [[Mérida, Mérida|Mérida]] in 1977.{{r|nacional}} In May 2024 the 33rd {{lang|es|Jornadas}} were held as a [[hybrid event]] in Caracas.{{r|nacional}}
The AMV also organises events to celebrate the [[International Day of Mathematics]].{{r|impulso}}

==Publications==
The AMV publishes the Bulletin of the Venezuelan Mathematical Association (Spanish: {{lang|es|Boletín de la AMV}}), which is the preeminent Venezuelan mathematics journal.{{r|mactutor}}
The journal is indexed by [[zbMATH]].{{r|zbmath}}

==Governance==
Each regional chapter of the AMV has one representative on the board of directors. As of 2024, the directors are:{{r|org}}
{{div col}}
*Caracas: Luis Angel Rodríguez (President of the AMV)
*Barquisimeto: Neptalí Romero
*Mérida: Oswaldo Araujo
*Maracaibo: Tobías Rosas
{{div col end}}

The regional chapters have autonomy to manage their own budget and activities.{{r|reglamento}}
